scope: Same accepted GNN teaching workflow rebuilt with HKUST physical inputs, freshly trained model and fresh independent hydraulic signals.

model.checkpoint_selection: Minimum validation loss only; no test results used.

hydraulics.scope: Controlled simulations with 40 m supply, zero initial demands/elevations and Darcy factor 0.02; no field-validation claim.

interactive_ui.detail: Python callbacks tested at multiple sensor/noise settings; static figures inspected.

limitations: Linux CPU execution was tested using Python 3.12.14, NumPy 1.26.4, Torch 2.15.0+cpu, WNTR 1.3.2 and TSNet 0.3.1.
Windows and physical NVIDIA GPU execution were not available.
Fresh Conda setup and pinned PyTorch 2.7.1 installation were not executed here.
Notebook execution used IPython in-process because ipykernel was unavailable; a fresh-kernel checker and Windows/Linux CPU CI are included.
The supplied GitHub Actions workflow has not been run remotely.
